item.title: Sierra takes 2nd in Gebhardt Cup
item.description: Sierra finished second and East Union fourth in Sierra High’s Vern Gebhardt Cup on Saturday. Lincoln (5-1-1) of Stockton downed the Timberwolves (10-2) 2-1 in the championship game.

item.title: Manteca, EU, Lathrop win Buff Collegiate Showcase finales
item.description: Manteca and Los Banos were locked in a scoreless tie for more than 70 minutes Saturday before Adriel Vega took a pass from Julian Oregel for the lone goal of the night in a 1-0 Buffaloes win to wrap up the two-day Buffalo Collegiate Showcase at Guss Schmiedt Field.

item.title: WEEKEND: Calderara, Ripon surge past Stagg for 1st boys basketball win
item.description: Ripon’s boys basketball team got off the schneid Saturday in Tracy, capping the West Tournament with a 59-46 over Stagg in the seventh-place game.
